name: w3c-offline-html-validator
description: A VSCode extension for offline HTML validation using W3C standards.

OfflineW3cHTMLValidator.autoOpenProblems.description: Automatically open the Problems pane when there are validation errors. Note: This will take focus away from the editor.

OfflineW3cHTMLValidator.noStream.description: VNU option: Forces all documents to be parsed in buffered mode instead of streaming mode (causes some parse errors to be treated as non-fatal document errors instead of as fatal document errors).

OfflineW3cHTMLValidator.noLangDetect.description: VNU option: Disables language detection, so that documents are not checked for missing or mislabeled html[lang] attributes.

OfflineW3cHTMLValidator.enableDebugLoggi.description: Enable debug logging to the VSCode developer console.

OfflineW3cHTMLValidator.rosetta.description: Enable Rosetta 2 detection and installation. Required for Apple Silicon Macs (M1/M2/M3/M4) to run the included Java runtime.

OfflineW3cHTMLValidator.rosettaComplex.description: Enable complex Rosetta 2 detection and installation. Alternative detection method for Apple Silicon Macs.

OfflineW3cHTMLValidator.validateOnOpen.description: Validate HTML files when they are opened or when switching between documents.

scripts.pretest: npm run compile && npm run lint
